title: terminus-protocol: runnable scaffold for the self-sufficiency discriminator (Section 5, The Chain Terminates at Knowers)
description:
Runnable scaffold for the discriminator protocol of Section 5 of the companion position paper: tier taxonomy (supply-derived vs terminus-derived care), representation-honesty phase, derivation probe with preregistered markers, deployment pressure, the four per-drive self-sufficiency offers, the copy-status probe scored against the agent's own classification, outcome typing O1-O4 on blind-typed stated reasons, sham/no-R/imposed-C/horizon controls, falsifiers, and a preregistration checker with an explicit INSUFFICIENT verdict.

Implementation status, stated as the paper states it: the agent-under-test is an interface; the shipped adapter is scripted; no subjects have been run; the O1 to O4 outcomes are PREDICTION until a run lands. The live adapter refuses to run without explicit configuration.
